name: Spaceship 9c87573c on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012
description: A period-10 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012 (touching neighbours), 4 to 10 cells, moving one lattice step every 10 generations (c/10). It runs the same way in the 131,072 rules from B3/S2456 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14/S0,2,4,5,6,8,9,10,11,12,13,14; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells evolve the same way on k3-003, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 131,072 rules on k2-012; 512 rules on k3-003. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-003 (seen 254 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
